common.demoNote: Demo mode: users, settings and the audit log are stored in local mock data. No server or database is connected.
common.adminOnly: These actions appear only in the administrator area. Clerks, quality staff, management and suppliers do not see them.
common.storageError: Could not save. Please try again.
common.protectedAdmin: The demo administrator role and status stay unchanged here, so sign-in remains available.
common.noDelete: Records are not deleted. Change the status instead.

dashboard.title: Administrator dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of user accounts, supplier approvals, system settings and the audit log.
dashboard.statusDescription: Pending, active, rejected and temporarily locked.

users.title: Users and roles
users.subtitle: Supplier and staff accounts. Review status and role here.
users.emptyHint: Try a different search or filter.

form.title: Create user
form.subtitle: A new staff or supplier account. Passwords are not stored separately — the demo password is demo1234.
form.name: Name
form.supplierStatusNote: A supplier created by an administrator is active immediately (BR-12).
form.staffStatusNote: A pending staff account must be activated before sign-in.
form.passwordNote: This demo signs in with the password demo1234. A separate password is not created.
form.errorUsername: Username needs at least 3 characters: letters, digits or dots.
form.errorDuplicate: This phone or email is already on another account.
form.errorStorage: Could not save. Please try again.

detail.title: User detail
detail.subtitle: Account information, status and role assignment.
detail.notFoundHint: The id is unknown or the account does not exist.
detail.roleHint: Staff roles can be changed among registration clerk, quality staff, management and administrator.
detail.supplierRoleHint: The supplier role stays on the registry record and is not reassigned here.
detail.statusHint: Pending, active, rejected and temporarily locked.
detail.lockNote: Lock duration and automatic unlock are not defined. An administrator unlocks the account manually.
detail.protectedNote: This is the demo administrator account. Role and status stay fixed.

approvals.title: Supplier registration approvals
approvals.subtitle: Self-registered suppliers waiting for a decision.
approvals.approveBody: {name} becomes active and can sign in.
approvals.rejectBody: {name} will be rejected. Write the reason.

dialogs.lockBody: {name} will not be able to sign in. No duration is set.
dialogs.activateBody: {name} will be able to sign in again.

settings.title: System settings
settings.subtitle: Documented configuration. Automatic lockout and session lifetime are not enforced in this demo.
settings.attemptsHint: The documented baseline is 5. This demo does not count failed attempts and does not lock accounts on the server.
settings.attemptsError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10.
settings.referenceDescription: These are not approved as editable values, so this page does not offer fields for them.
settings.session: Target access-token lifetime is 8 hours. It has not been confirmed against Supabase.
settings.lockDuration: Temporary lock duration and automatic unlock are not defined.
settings.retention: Audit retention period is not defined.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Each change shows who did it, when, and what changed.
